name: Kraemer Family Library
notes: Current official library homepage confirms core services. Reflection-room details in the supplied research were not independently confirmed.
description: Find study spaces, course reserves, library collections, databases, and research help.

name: Library collections and checkouts
notes: Borrowing verified. Specific manga, games, DVD, and special-collection inventory changes; confirm item availability in catalog.
eligibility: Borrowing privileges depend on UCCS or community borrower status.

name: Banned Books events
notes: Historical official event page found. Current semester mystery-book packages and repeat schedule were not verified.

name: Library equipment borrowing
notes: Official equipment article confirms ID and checkout location. Check current inventory and loan periods.
description: Borrow chargers, dry-erase markers, umbrellas and other equipment from Library Assistance.
bring: Digital student ID in the UCCS app, or a physical photo ID such as a driver’s license.
access: Visit the Library Assistance Desk; availability varies.

name: Textbook course reserves
notes: Availability and loan rules depend on the course and item; this does not guarantee every textbook is available.
description: Check whether required books or other course materials are available through library reserves.

name: Study room reservations
notes: Live reservation page says 30-day booking window, while an older student-services page says 7 days. Use the live booking page; reservations may be canceled if more than 30 minutes late.
access: Reserve your own room at least 24 hours ahead, up to 30 days ahead. Limit: 3 hours per day and 9 hours per week.

name: UCCS University Archives
notes: Access and appointment requirements vary by collection; consult Archives.
description: Explore university history and archival collections.

name: Library digital exhibits
notes: Official page found. Unlisted access terms and hours still require provider confirmation.
description: Explore online exhibits from the Kraemer Family Library.

name: KFL A–Z databases
notes: Access depends on affiliation and individual database licensing; sign-in may be required.
description: Browse licensed research databases through the library.

name: Academic journals and research databases
notes: Institutional access does not bypass every paywall or include every title. Check coverage or request research assistance.
access: Use the library’s database links and UCCS sign-in for licensed content.

name: BrowZine
notes: Official page found. Unlisted access terms and hours still require provider confirmation.
description: Find, read and follow scholarly journals available through the library.

name: Prospector
notes: Official library circulation page links Prospector. Availability and borrowing periods vary.
description: Request eligible materials from partner libraries through Prospector.

name: New York Times access
notes: Register using the instructions on the library page; ongoing eligibility terms apply.
eligibility: Current UCCS students, faculty and staff.
cost: Free All Digital Access account through the library.

name: Author talks and book events
notes: Official library homepage is a starting point. No current recurring author-tabing program or schedule independently verified.

name: Library cards and alumni borrowing
notes: The source claim of a forever card is oversimplified. Alumni borrowing continues, but most e-books, journals and databases are unavailable off campus to alumni. Selected alumni databases require an active alumni account.
eligibility: UCCS alumni may obtain alumni borrowing privileges.
access: Present alumni membership card at the library Circulation Desk.
description: Continue eligible library borrowing after graduation, with different off-campus electronic-resource access.

name: Document scanning
notes: Current library and PawPrints pages agree emailed scans are free. Copy pricing differs between pages, so use the OIT PawPrints rate table for printing rather than older library copy prices.

name: Campus computers and PawPrints
notes: The $1 credit is an initial new-user credit, not a recurring allowance. OIT lists grayscale simplex $0.10/page, grayscale duplex $0.14/sheet and color simplex $0.30/page; check current table before printing.
cost: New users receive a one-time $1 PawPrints credit. Afterward printing is charged to Clyde’s Cash. Scan-to-email is free.
eligibility: Current students, faculty and staff; alumni and public patron printing are not supported.
bring: UCCS login or Lion OneCard/Mobile ID; Clyde’s Cash after initial credit.
location: Kraemer Family Library computer commons and other supported campus labs.
description: Use campus computers and the Paw Prints printing, copying, and scanning service.

name: Zoom
notes: Use UCCS-domain licensing and account settings; no claim that every Zoom plan or feature is included.
access: Sign in at uccs-edu.zoom.us using UCCS credentials.

name: Microsoft 365
notes: The source says unlimited access; the official catalog confirms listed apps through university affiliation, not unlimited licenses or lifetime access.
description: UCCS access to Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, OneNote and OneDrive.

name: CU ChatGPT Edu
notes: OIT lists general availability beginning March 31, 2026. Follow the university AI site for account eligibility, setup and use policies.
description: UCCS guidance and resources for its university ChatGPT service.

name: LinkedIn Learning
notes: Certification preparation may be included; certification exam fees are not automatically included.
access: Access through your campus student portal.

name: Coursera through CU
notes: CU sponsorship covers designated learning programs, not all courses or paid degrees on Coursera.
eligibility: CU-sponsored non-credit learning programs are available to faculty, staff and degree-seeking students.
access: Use the CU-sponsored program through the student portal.

name: Skillsoft Percipio
notes: Online learning and exam preparation verified. The supplied claim of free technical certifications does not establish that exam vouchers or certification fees are covered.
access: Log in through the student portal.
description: Online courses and certification preparation through CU. Exam fees and vouchers are not automatically included.

name: Qualtrics
notes: Follow university survey and data-use requirements; student eligibility verified.
description: Create and conduct online surveys.
eligibility: Currently enrolled UCCS students and active faculty/staff.
access: Visit surveyuccs.qualtrics.com and use UCCS credentials.

name: UCCS Virtual Labs
notes: The supplied document promises Adobe Suite access. Available licensed applications vary; official knowledge base warns some licensed software may not yet be available.
description: Access a cloud-hosted Windows lab desktop remotely.
eligibility: UCCS students, faculty and staff who require OIT lab resources.
access: Sign in at virtuallabs.uccs.edu using UCCS credentials.

name: SPSS lab access
notes: Official OIT sources describe concurrent-use licensing across the OIT lab image, rather than restricting this resource to graduate sociology students.
eligibility: Current UCCS students, faculty and staff with OIT lab access.
cost: Provided on supported OIT lab computers; personal copies can be purchased separately.
description: Statistical analysis software on supported OIT lab computers; personal license terms differ.

name: OIT software catalog
notes: Licensing, fees and access vary by product; do not assume everything in the catalog is free.
description: Check campus-supported software, licensing, eligibility and lab availability.

name: OIT Service Desk
notes: OIT contact page hours differ from service-page sidebar hours (Monday–Friday 8am–6pm). Contact provider to confirm hours. Device recycling/donation claim was not independently verified.
hours: Contact page lists Monday–Thursday, 8am–5pm; confirm before visiting.

name: UCCS Laptop Program
notes: Official UCCS 2021 news confirmed a Chromebook loan program, but the current laptop.uccs.edu endpoint was inaccessible during review. Current availability, eligibility and loan terms need verification through OIT.

name: UCCS Linux server access
notes: Generic OIT services page only. Current universal student SSH access, server address and eligibility were not established. Ask OIT or your academic department; do not use the source as connection instructions.

name: GitHub Student Developer Pack and Copilot
notes: Not limited to computer science majors. Partner offers and usage limits vary. GitHub’s current plan is Copilot Student.

sources.title: GitHub Student Developer Pack and Copilot

description: Apply for verified student developer tools and GitHub Copilot Student.
eligibility: Students age 13+ enrolled in a degree- or diploma-granting program; GitHub verification required.
access: Apply using school-issued email and/or official dated proof of enrollment.

name: JetBrains Student Pack
notes: Educational licenses have use restrictions; review current JetBrains terms.
cost: Free educational Student Pack after verification.
access: Verify student status with an accepted school email, enrollment document or other supported method.

name: Azure for Students
notes: Azure is not an unlimited free cloud account. Use limits and eligible products apply.
cost: Eligible students receive $100 credit for 12 months plus selected free service amounts; no credit card required.
access: Verify student status; annual renewal is available while eligible.

name: Figma for Education
notes: This is a provider education offer, not a UCCS-provided campus software license.
cost: Free Education plan for eligible students and educators.
access: Verify education status and create an Education team.

name: Miro Education
notes: Approval and team limits apply.
cost: Free Education plan for eligible educational users.
access: Apply with education affiliation and supporting documentation as requested.

name: Notion for Education
notes: Education plan benefits depend on individual or student-organization eligibility; review current provider terms.
access: Verify student status with a supported school email; annual re-verification may be required.

name: Mountain Metro student bus passes
notes: The supplied claim that every student can obtain a free pass omits availability limits. The official page expressly lists first-come, first-served distribution and limited commuter passes.
description: Request a student pass for unlimited Mountain Metro rides around Colorado Springs.
eligibility: On-campus residents; limited commuter passes first come, first served; hardship or emergency needs through the Dean of Students.
access: Off-campus students request via the parking portal. Follow email instructions, verify a RideMMT account and add a mobile barcode or Metro Card.

name: Campus shuttle
notes: This replaces the source’s approximate 12-hour service claim. Check current semester routes, breaks, weather and closures; no service to Downtown campus, Heller Center or Lot 580.
description: Accessible shuttle service between main-campus stops and scheduled Cybersecurity Center trips.
hours: Fall 2026: Monday–Friday Aug 24–Dec 18, excluding Sep 7 and Nov 23–27. First main-campus bus 6:40am; last University Hall departure 10:08pm. Daytime departures about every 10–12 minutes, evenings 15–20 minutes.

name: UCCS Safe App
notes: Official university safety app verified. Follow official app instructions; app functions require appropriate device permissions.
description: Access campus safety alerts, emergency contacts, incident reporting and Friend Walk.

name: Campus safety escorts
notes: Contact campus police to ask about current escort availability and scope; vehicle escorts are not guaranteed by this review.
description: Campus Police safety programs include escorts and virtual escort options in UCCS Safe.

name: Visitor weekend parking
notes: Restricted spaces, disabled spaces, fire lanes, roadways, unmarked stalls and timed zones are enforced 24/7/365. Source claim free across all locations was too broad.
cost: No permit registration required on weekends, university-closed holidays and semester breaks.
hours: Saturdays and Sundays; other listed breaks/holidays.

name: 500-series parking
notes: Parking is not permit-free simply because the permit costs $0; signed restrictions still apply.
eligibility: Students with a registered vehicle; paid student permits also cover 500-series lots.
access: Register vehicle and link license plate to your permit in the parking portal.

name: Campus and accessibility maps
notes: Use current campus map information for accessible routes and entrances; conditions may change.
description: Find official campus, parking and transportation maps.

name: Lost and found
notes: Official shuttle page identifies the UC Information Desk for found bus items; some items transfer to UCCS Police. Other building-specific drop points from the source were not verified.
location: University Center Information Desk for shuttle-found items.

name: Microwaves on campus
notes: University Center parent page only. Specific microwave inventory, access and source locations were not independently confirmed; contact the building or department.

name: Lion OneCard
notes: Benefits depend on enrollment, account setup, meal plan, fees and access permissions; the card does not make every service free.
description: Use your campus ID for eligible residence, dining, printing, recreation, library and event access.
access: Follow the official Mobile ID setup guide or contact the Lion OneCard office.
